assistant.name: Nautilus
assistant.greeting: 🌊 Welcome aboard! I'm Nautilus, your deep sea guide. Ask me anything about ocean exploration.

terms.intro: Welcome to the deep sea exploration chatbot. Please review and accept the following terms before diving in.
terms.acceptInstruction: By clicking Accept, you confirm that you have read and agree to the terms above. Your chat history will be stored for quality improvement.
terms.scamNoticeBefore: Nautilus will never ask for your personal or financial information. If you have concerns, please contact our support team at
terms.scamNoticeAfter: for assistance. You must accept the terms to continue.

hotline.label: Ocean Support Hotline
hotline.description: Available 24/7 for technical support and inquiries about the Nautilus chatbot service.

mockChat.reply: Fascinating question! The deepest part of the ocean is the Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench, approximately 11,034 meters (36,201 feet) below sea level. 🐟 Would you like to learn more about deep sea creatures?
